get.summary:
Every change in the caller's workspace as it happens, merged from the
three services (CONTRACT.md §8, "Live events"). Each `data:` line is a
`PlatformEvent`. The stream never ends: a service that goes away is
reconnected with backoff while the others keep flowing, so the web app
opens it once per tab and invalidates its caches by `entity`. Events
of other workspaces (or without one) are dropped here (§18).

200.description: Server-Sent Events, one PlatformEvent per message; never ends

429.description: The workspace holds too many open streams on this replica

finishedAt.description: When it ended; null while it is open.

previousReleaseId.description: What the environment ran when the run started.

releaseVersion.description: Release version when the run started.

startedBy.description: Who started it (`system` for automatic promotions).

failure that still waits for a remediation.

commitSha.description: Commit the diagram was generated from.

explanation.description: 60–150 words: what the diagram shows and its evidence limits.

mermaid.description: Mermaid rendered from the spec, or the user's edited source. `null` in list responses.

dashed.description: Inferred rather than observed; drawn dashed.

evidencePath.description: File that shows the relationship; empty when inferred.

DiagramGroup.description: A tinted region of related nodes.

id.description: Group id, unique within the diagram.

path.description: Repository directory the group stands for, when there is one.

caption.description: Short type caption under the label, e.g. "axum", "PostgreSQL".

groupId.description: Group the node sits in; empty for none.

id.description: Node id, unique within the diagram.

path.description: Repository path the node stands for; the code browser opens it. Empty for actors and external systems.

DiagramSpec.description: The diagram's groups, nodes and edges: the single source of truth for rendering.

DiffHunk.description: One `@@` section of a unified diff.

lines.description: Diff lines including their leading ` `, `+` or `-`.

newLines.description: Lines of the hunk in the new file.

newStart.description: First line of the hunk in the new file.

oldLines.description: Lines of the hunk in the old file.

oldStart.description: First line of the hunk in the old file.

Document.description: A document generated from the knowledge model.

markdown.description: Markdown body. Empty in list responses.

Environment.description: A place a release runs, and how it gets there.

autoPromote.description: Promote here automatically when the previous stage succeeds (still gated).

config.description: Deployer settings; keys per kind in CONTRACT.md §22. Secrets are named, never held.

currentReleaseId.description: The release that runs there now; null before the first successful deployment.

healthPath.description: Path polled on `url` after a deploy; null when not configured.

registryId.description: Registry its images come from; null uses the workspace default.

url.description: Where the environment is reachable; null when not configured.

message.description: Human-readable explanation safe to show in the UI.

EvidenceKind.description: Where a piece of evidence points.

Execution.description: A plan being run as a DAG, one action at a time.

adapter.description: Adapter in use; `simulated` is a dry run.

oneOf.description: Present while paused on a failure.

finishedAt.description: When it reached a terminal state.

lastCheckpoint.description: Key of the last checkpointed step.

patternId.description: Pattern it came from, if any.

proposalId.description: Proposal it came from, if any.

seq.description: Monotonic per execution; use it to resume a watch.

ExecutionStatus.description: State of the execution state machine (CONTRACT.md §7).

Fact.description: Something known about a project, with its evidence.

evidence.description: Short excerpt that proves the fact.

sourcePath.description: Repository path the fact came from.

value.description: Value, e.g. a version or a path.

blockedSteps.description: Step keys that cannot run until this is resolved.

missingPermissions.description: Permissions the identity was missing, for `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

detail.description: Markdown: the evidence and the fix.

endLine.description: Last line of the range; equals `line` for a single line.

line.description: Line in the new file; 0 for a file-level finding.

suggestion.description: Replacement for the referenced lines, when the fix is mechanical; becomes a GitHub suggestion.

prompt.description: Free text for `custom` (a prompt, or Mermaid source to import), or a focus hint for other kinds.

budgetMonthlyUsd.description:

GithubAccount.description: The GitHub account behind the configured token.

error.description: Set when the token is missing or GitHub rejected it.

name.description: Display name, when set on the profile.

privateRepos.description: Number of private repositories visible to the token.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes granted to the token.

tokenConfigured.description: False when no token is configured; the other fields are then empty.

GithubRepo.description: A repository the token can see.

fork.description: True when the repository is a fork.

projectId.description: Project id when this repository is already connected.

ttlMinutes.description: Lifetime in minutes. Empty or 0 uses the default of 30.

Graph.description: Nodes and edges of one project.

GraphEdge.description: A temporal edge: `validTo` unset means "still true".

validTo.description: When it stopped holding; null while current.

GraphNode.description: A node of the project knowledge graph.

sourcePath.description: Repository path the node came from.

status.description: Always `ok` when the gateway can answer at all.

Identity.description: The scoped identity actions run as. Never an administrator.

ImpactAnalysis.description: What a change to one node would touch.

ImpactedNode.description: A node reached from the origin.

via.description: Relations walked from the origin to reach this node.

url.description: Where to send an organisation owner to install the SDI GitHub App.

oneOf.description: Signal weights every new proposal starts from.

reasoner.description: `heuristic` or `claude`. `claude` needs `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and falls back otherwise.

reasonerModel.description: Model name next to provider and base URL (same value as `model`).

costCeilingUsd.description: Options above this monthly cost lose ranking unless a budget says otherwise.

oneOf.description: Signal weights every new proposal starts from. Replaced as a whole.

reasonerBaseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

reasonerDailyTokenCap.description: Daily token budget of the reasoner.

reasonerTokensToday.description: Reasoner tokens (input + output) spent today, UTC (CONTRACT.md §19).

refId.description: Id of the object the chunk belongs to (pattern id, decision id, ...).

pipelineRunsLimit.description: Pipeline runs synced from the provider per refresh.

scanMaxFileBytes.description: Maximum size of one analysed file in bytes.

KnowledgeSettingsPatch.description:

unset fields keep their current value.

pipelineRunsLimit.description: Pipeline runs synced from the provider per refresh.

scanMaxFileBytes.description: Maximum size of one analysed file in bytes.

MaturityAxis.description: One of the eight delivery maturity axes (CONTRACT.md §13).

recommendedPatterns.description: Pattern ids that would raise this axis, best first.

axes.description: The eight axes in display order.

currentWorkspaceId.description: The workspace this request was resolved in.

workspaces.description: Every workspace the user can open, personal first.

oneOf.description: Admin override, never above `derivedRole`; null when none.

syncedAt.description: When GitHub was last read; null before the first sync.

changedRecommendation.description: True when this assistant turn switched the recommended option.

optionId.description: Option whose artifacts to commit. Empty uses the recommended option.

costLines.description: The catalog's cost model: the baseline a proposal rescales per project.

requires.description: Capability keys a project must have, e.g. `dockerfile`.

targetsAxes.description: Maturity axes a modernization pattern raises (CONTRACT.md §13 keys); empty otherwise.

usedBy.description: Project names that use this pattern.

PatternStatus.description: Whether a pattern is still offered.

expiresAt.description: Expiry; null for the identity's base scope.

Person.description:
The public face of a user, for naming who did something. Never carries
the email address.

member.description: False for someone who acted in this workspace and has since left it.

name.description: Display name, when set on the profile.

Pipeline.description: A pipeline definition found in the repository.

PipelineJob.description: One job of a pipeline definition.

PipelineRun.description: One pipeline run observed at the provider.

syncedAt.description: When the runs were last synced from the provider.

PipelineStage.description: One stage of a project's pipeline.

oneOf.description: Newest release ahead of `current` that already succeeded in the previous stage (any release for the first stage).

health.description: `healthy`, `unhealthy` or `unknown` (no URL configured): a live check, cached for 30 seconds.

PipelineStats.description: Aggregate over the listed pipeline runs.

PlanStep.description:

executions so a plan keeps its shape end to end.

adapter.description: Tool adapter that would run it: `github`, `docker`, `cloud`, `kubernetes`, `local` or `simulated`.

dependsOn.description: Keys of the steps that must succeed first (edges of the execution DAG).

description.description: What the step does, in plain words.

key.description: Stable key within the plan, referenced by `dependsOn`.

params.description: Free-form parameters handed to the adapter.

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions the executing identity must hold, e.g. `database:write`.

title.description: Short human title of the step.

verification.description: How success is verified after the action, in plain words.

PlatformEvent.description:
A change notification from one of the services, as streamed by
`GET /events/stream`. The web app invalidates its query caches by
`entity` (CONTRACT.md §8, "Live events").

entityId.description: Id of the entity that changed.

projectId.description: Project the entity belongs to; null for entities not tied to one.

status.description: Entity status after the change, in the entity's own vocabulary (e.g. `scanning`).

Policy.description: The decision applied to one action type.

editable.description: False for defaults that must not be relaxed.

PolicyDecision.description: What the policy says to do with an action before it runs.

hasConfig.description: True when the repository carries a `.sdi.yml`.

lastScanId.description: Id of the latest scan, if any.

maturityScore.description: Delivery maturity 0–100 (CONTRACT.md §13). 0 until the first scan succeeds.

tldr.description: One-line understanding. Empty until the first scan succeeds.

ProjectConfig.description:
What the repository declared in `.sdi.yml` (CONTRACT.md §12). Values that
the file does not set are null, so the UI can tell "not configured" from
a configured empty value.

budgetMonthlyUsd.description: Monthly budget in USD; becomes the budget constraint on every proposal.

errors.description: Parse problems, in plain words. The config is ignored when non-empty.

path.description: Repository path of the file, when present.

present.description: True when the repository carries the file.

testCommand.description: Test command used by the docker adapter's `tests.run_local`.

ProjectMode.description: Observe is read-only analysis (the default); execute allows policy-gated actions.

releaseId.description: Release to deploy; null promotes the stage's candidate.

Proposal.description: A ranked, evidence-backed set of options for one project.

acceptedOptionId.description: Option that was accepted, if any.

executionId.description: Execution created from the accepted option, if any.

prompt.description: What the user asked for, if anything.

revision.description: Bumped every time negotiation re-ranks the options.

ProposalKind.description:
What a proposal is about. `modernization` moves a legacy or transitional
project up the maturity axes (CONTRACT.md §6).

ProposalOption.description:
One ranked option of a proposal. The generated files are not inlined
(they can be large); `artifactCount` says how many
`GET /proposals/{id}/options/{optionId}/artifacts` returns.

artifactCount.description: Number of generated files; fetch them from the artifacts route.

patternId.description: Pattern the option is built from.

unmetRequirements.description: Pattern requirements this project does not meet yet.

PullRequest.description: One pull request with its files, diff and knowledge links.

impactedNodeIds.description: Graph node ids the change reaches (impact walk from every changed path, at most 60).

touchedFactIds.description: Facts whose evidence lives in a changed file.

PullRequestSummary.description: A pull request as GitHub lists it, with the id of its latest SDI review.

changedFiles.description: Files changed, as GitHub counts them.

headSha.description: Head commit; a review is identified by it.

htmlUrl.description: Link to the pull request on GitHub.

latestReviewId.description: The latest SDI review of this pull request, if any.

projectId.description: Project the pull request belongs to.

syncedAt.description: When the list was last synced from GitHub; null before the first sync.

Question.description: Something the scan could not know. Asked once, remembered afterwards.

allowFreeText.description: True when a free-text answer is accepted.

prompt.description: The question shown to the user.

reason.description: Why the platform could not detect it on its own.

Registry.description: Where images live. One per workspace is the default; GHCR needs no secret.

auth.description: `github_token` (GHCR), `oidc` (cloud registries, reachable from CI only) or `secret`.

isDefault.description: True for the registry releases use when their environment names none.

namespace.description: Org, user or project path images are pushed under.

passwordSecret.description: Name of the workspace secret holding the password or token; null unless `auth` is `secret`.

usernameSecret.description: Name of the workspace secret holding the user name (never the value); null unless `auth` is `secret`.

Release.description: One immutable image at one commit.

commitSha.description: Commit the image was built from.

deployedTo.description: Names of the environments this release currently runs in, in promotion order.

digest.description: `sha256:…` once known; null before the registry or the build reported it.

notes.description: Commit subjects since the previous release, Markdown.

pipelineRunId.description: The CI run that built it, when a webhook created the release.

verified.description: The registry confirmed the manifest exists.

version.description: Tag shown to people, e.g. `v1.4.2` or the short SHA.

effect.description: What choosing it changes in the plan.

binary.description: The file is not text (NUL bytes or a known binary extension).

factIds.description: Ids of the facts detected from this file.

language.description: Lowercase language id from the extension; empty when unknown.

truncated.description: Content was cut at the 1 MiB limit; `size` is the real size.

commitSha.description: Commit the last successful scan analysed.

entries.description: Files and directories, sorted by path.

truncated.description: GitHub truncated the recursive tree (very large repositories).

RepoTreeEntry.description: One file or directory of the repository tree.

language.description: Lowercase language id from the extension, e.g. `typescript`; empty when unknown.

instruction.description: Free-text instruction instead of an option.

optionId.description: One of the failure's remediation option ids.

Review.description: A review of one pull request at one head commit.

error.description: Why it failed, when it did.

ReviewActivity.description: One entry of the review activity log.

actor.description: Who did it (`system` for the pipeline).

ReviewStatus.description: Where a review is in its pipeline.

ReviewStep.description: One step of the review rail.

detail.description: What the step found or why it failed.

releaseId.description: Release to go back to; null picks the previous successful one.

RunFailure.description: Root cause of a failed run.

architectureFit.description: Share of pattern requirements the project meets.

recency.description: Decay since the pattern was last used.

semanticSimilarity.description: Cosine similarity between project profile and pattern.

updatedBy.description: Login of whoever stored it last.

detail.description: Error text when the check failed.

latencyMs.description: Round trip of the health check in milliseconds.

url.description: gRPC endpoint the gateway talks to.

apiKey.description: The workspace's own model API key; empty removes it. Never returned.

intelligence.description: Ranking defaults and the reasoner (intelligence service).

oneOf.description: Fault to inject during the dry run, if any.

approvalId.description: Approval gating this step, if any.

output.description: Tool output of the last attempt.

requestFlow.description: Ordered hops a request takes through the system.
